note: The Claude Code configuration VELDO-0060 qualifies on Linux. Every value is read from the installed binary: its digest and stream formats from proof/VELDO-0062/cli-formats.json, its command line from proof/VELDO-0060/cli-options.json. A version not listed here, or a pinned copy whose digest differs, is refused before anything is spawned; upgrading is a deliberate requalification that adds a version. VELDO-0155: the version is qualified with the everything-off baseline read from the same binary (proof/VELDO-0155/claude-baseline.json); a record without it refuses every launch of the version. VELDO-0155 AC3: the version is also qualified with stream JSON input (--input-format stream-json, which the binary accepts only with stream JSON output in print mode), so the prompt waits for the login check; a record without it refuses every launch of the version.

2.1.281.input: stream JSON input (VELDO-0155 AC3): the initialize control request first, then the dispatch packet as the user message only once the answer names a subscription login
